title: Readiness Buoy — KPI Ledger & Contingency Buoyancy Plan
summary: Working ledger for product ops to track go-to-prod readiness using a lightweight "buoy" metaphor. The Buoyancy Index collapses multiple signals into a single health number for rapid triage. This doc is intentionally informal: quick tables, TODOs, and an operational contingency matrix for the next sprint and soft-launch window.
kpi_snapshot: API p50 latency (prod-cold) | 78ms | <60ms | 120ms | sample skew from long tails on small batches
Token cost per 1k (avg) | $0.85 | $0.65 | $1.10 | quantization savings projected but untested
Successful responses (%) | 99.92% | 99.99% | 99.5% | transient error spikes during deploys
Cache hit rate (prefix KV) | 36% | 55% | 25% | improving with hot-prefix mapping
Customer-facing SLO breach window (minutes/day) | 25 | 0 | 60 | measured over rolling 24h

contingency_triggers: Buoyancy Index drops below 40% for >10 minutes
Sustained token-cost delta > +30% vs forecast for 24h
Error rate > 1% for system-critical routes for 30m
Region outage in primary region affecting >=50% of cross-region routes
contingency_actions: Automated action: throttle non-critical telemetry + reduce batch sizes until Buoyancy recovers
Fallback action: shift traffic to compatible model-variant (v2-v2-small) with blue-green swap script
Manual action: activate on-call bridge, escalate to infra SRE + product-ops lead
Billing action: enable spend-limit pause for specific tenant classes (enterprise & reserved)
roll_forward_rules: If canary shows p95 within 10% of baseline and error delta < 0.1%, advance to next canary step
If cost-per-token is >15% above baseline but quality gain > 6% as measured by eval prompts, allow gated rollout after PO signoff
If any critical regression in eval suite, halt rollout and roll back to last stable tag within 15 minutes
canary_config: Phase 1: 5% traffic, 45m observation, synthetic probes every 30s
Phase 2: 25% traffic, 3h observation, enable autoscale buffer + KV cache priming
Phase 3: 60% traffic, 24h observation, enable billing guardrails, run full regression evals
Abort criteria: p50 > baseline + 50ms OR error rate > baseline * 2
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cold-start tails cause p95 spikes — Mitigation: pre-warm pool + reduce model shards
Risk: Unanticipated cost uplift from rare prompts — Mitigation: token-sampling monitor + soft quota enforcement
Risk: Canary not representative due to synthetic probes — Mitigation: mix of synthetic + sampled real traffic
Risk: Observability blindspots for private deployments — Mitigation: verify log-forwarding and agent versions on customer VPCs
